name: biff-scheduler
description: BIFF 电影节排片工具 - Cloudflare Pages 纯静态 + Vite/TS

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && vite build
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name biff-scheduler --branch production --commit-dirty=true
